message:
I remember the last time we had a power outage, and it turned into an unexpected family adventure! My kids were initially bummed about the lack of screens, but I pulled out our trusty flashlights and started a little scavenger hunt around the house. We ended up making shadow puppets on the walls and creating our own little stories. 

It reminded me how important it is to be prepared, not just with flashlights and power banks, but also with a mindset that can turn a dull moment into fun. 

Have you ever had a similar experience? I’d love to hear your tips for making the most of a blackout!
